nodes.label: hb_init / hb_start / hb_stop
nodes.desc: hb_handle_t lifecycle. hb_init() starts the 'libhb' monitor thread; hb_start() flips state to HB_STATE_WORKING and spawns the work thread; hb_stop() just sets a die flag.

nodes.label: hb_scan()
nodes.desc: Title scan entry point: default preview_count is 10, and it short-circuits when the same source was already scanned.

nodes.label: HB_STATE_* machine
nodes.desc: IDLE, SCANNING, SCANDONE, WORKING, PAUSED, WORKDONE, MUXING, SEARCHING bitmask; every UI callback consumes it.

nodes.label: ScanFunc + DecodePreviews
nodes.desc: The 'scan' thread: decodes at least 3 previews per title (10 by default) to detect features, audio, and crop.

nodes.label: work_func / do_job
nodes.desc: Pops queued jobs, expands multi-pass encodes, then wires decoder, sync, filters, encoder, and muxer into job->list_work.

nodes.label: hb_fifo_* queues
nodes.desc: Fixed-capacity buffer queues (16/32 entries typical) that couple every stage and provide backpressure between threads.

nodes.label: hb_reader
nodes.desc: Source-side work object: demuxes Blu-ray/DVD/stream input into packet fifos; the only worker with no fifo_in.

nodes.label: hb_sync_video
nodes.desc: Aligns audio/video on timestamps and owns the progress + ETA math the UI displays.

nodes.label: Video filter chain
nodes.desc: Deinterlace/decomb, crop/scale, subtitles, etc.: one thread + mini-fifo per filter, with optional libavfilter graphs.

nodes.label: libavcodec decoders
nodes.desc: hb_decavcodecv / hb_decavcodeca wrap avcodec_send_packet + avcodec_receive_frame for video and audio.

nodes.label: libavcodec + x264/x265 encoders
nodes.desc: hb_encavcodec plus the x264/x265/SVT-AV1 wrappers; NVENC, QSV, VAAPI, and MediaFoundation hardware paths.

nodes.label: hb_muxer
nodes.desc: Terminal work object: drains fifo_out and writes the finished container (MP4/MKV/WebM) via libavformat.
